Background UNICEF Bosnia and Herzegovina is implementing two complementary EU-funded actions under the Instrument for Pre-Accession Assistance (IPA III). The EU4PEOPLE – Social Protection Programme (IPA 2022) is led by UNICEF as lead agency, in partnership with UNDP, UNFPA and ILO, and supports a modernised, EU-aligned social protection system by strengthening Centres for Social Welfare (CSWs) and their digitalisation, expanding licensed, community-based social services, and improving inspection and quality assurance. As lead agency, UNICEF is responsible for the overall communication and visibility of the joint programme, including coordination of partner UN agencies, management of programme events and consolidated visibility reporting to the EU. The Roma Assistance Programme (IPA 2022 and 2024; EUR 12 million, 36 months) is led by UNDP, with UNICEF and UNFPA as participating UN agencies and UNESCO and IOM sub-contracted. It aims to improve the social inclusion of Roma and protect their rights, with UNICEF responsible for components on access to health insurance and immunisation through Roma health mediators, school enrolment and completion, prevention of child marriage and Roma-led child rights monitoring. Assignment Provide dedicated, office-based communication support to the two EU-funded programmes over 36 months, weighted to reflect UNICEF’s role in each: approximately 70% of time for EU4PEOPLE, where UNICEF is lead agency, and 30% for the Roma Assistance Programme, where UNICEF is a participating agency. Event management and media relations: planning and running events end-to-end (logistics, protocol, vendors, visibility) and organising press events and media outreach. Ethical and inclusive communication: ethical reporting on children, informed consent and data protection; respectful, non-stigmatising communication with and about Roma communities. Organisation and teamwork: ability to manage two portfolios in parallel, prioritise, meet deadlines and work with multiple agencies and partners Desirables: Experience with UN agencies or joint UN programmes. Experience communicating on social protection, child rights, social inclusion, Roma or other marginalised groups; experience with community-facing or social and behaviour change materials. review_candidates.title: Baker
review_candidates.description: Amentum is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. Our people apply undaunted curiosity, relentless ambition and boundless imagination to challenge convention and drive progress. Our commitments are underpinned by the belief that safety, collaboration and well-being are integral to success. Amentum is seeking a Baker to support a unique US Navy program on the island of Diego Garcia. The Baker will be responsible for preparing a variety of bakery products in accordance with standardized recipes while ensuring the highest standards of food quality, safety, and sanitation. This position supports daily food service operations by producing fresh baked goods, maintaining a clean and organized work environment, and assisting with bakery operations to ensure efficient and consistent service. Job Responsibilities: Prepare breads, pastries, desserts, and other bakery products according to standardized recipes and established production schedules. Ensure all bakery items are consistently prepared to meet quality, presentation, and food safety standards. Accurately measure, weight, and adjust ingredients to ensure recipe consistency and product quality. Maintain strict compliance with food safety, sanitation, and personal hygiene standards in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements. Keep workstations, equipment, and storage areas clean, organized, and sanitized throughout each shift. Record daily production quantities and food waste to support inventory control and operational reporting. Complete daily, weekly, and monthly cleaning schedules and maintain required documentation. Ensure bakery production is completed to support the next shift and maintain uninterrupted food services operations. Assist with inventory management by properly storing ingredients and rotating stock using first in, first out practices. Provide direction and support to bakery staff in the absence of the head baker. Perform other job-related duties as assigned that are consistent with the nature and level of the position. Required Qualifications: High school diploma or equivalent. Minimum of one (1) year of baking experience in a full service, commercial, or institutional food service environment. Current ServSafe certification or equivalent food safety certification required. Ability to read, understand, and follow standardized recipes. Strong English communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with customers, supervisors, and team members. Must be in possession of a valid passport and be able to travel internationally. Passport must be valid for a minimum of one (1) year or more at the time of hiring. Ability to obtain country-specific visas per the U.S. Department of State Foreign Clearance Guide. Ability to successfully pass contract medical requirements and maintain compliance throughout the duration of deployment. Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. Employees must read, speak, and comprehend English to the extent that they can perform the contract requirements and comply with installation emergency procedures. Preferred Qualifications: Prior experience working in an austere OCONUS (Outside the Continental United States) environment with a multi-national workforce A valid driver’s license to legally operate a motor vehicle. Valid country driver’s license. and passport. Experience working multiple food service stations, including grill and general food preparation. Strong organizational, time management, and customer service skills. Other Responsibilities: Safety: Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements, fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks, and serving on safety committees and teams. Quality: Quality is the foundation for the management of our business and the keystone to our goal of customer satisfaction. It is our policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Accordingly, each employee must conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts. Each employee must read and understand their Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities. Procedure Compliance: Each employee must read, understand, and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality, and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures, and policies pertaining to the job. Working Environment This position is located on Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory (BIOT), a remote overseas location supporting U.S. Government operations. Employees may work in office, industrial, warehouse, port, airfield, and outdoor environments and may be exposed to high temperatures, humidity, inclement weather, noise, dust, and uneven terrain. Work schedules may include evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on operational requirements. Physical Requirements Requirements may include prolonged sitting, standing, walking, climbing stairs, and working in both indoor and outdoor environments. Must be able to meet all medical, security, and deployment requirements associated with assignment to a remote overseas location.
